component.name: Mountie
component.summary: GUI to Mount and manage network shares

description.p: Mountie keeps your network shares in one place and mounts them with a single toggle. It handles SMB/CIFS, AFP, NFS, SFTP, FTP and WebDAV through GVfs. No administrator rights are needed and nothing has to be added to fstab.

ul.li: Add, edit and remove shares for any host and protocol GVfs supports
Mount and unmount with one click, with status shown for each share
Passwords are stored in the system keyring, never on disk in plain text
Each mounted share gets a short, stable path such as ~/Shares/Photos, instead of the long generated GVfs location
Light and dark themes, following the desktop's own preference and accent color by default

description.p: Mountie works on any desktop that provides GVfs and a secret service, including COSMIC, GNOME and KDE Plasma.

screenshot.caption: Every configured share with its connection status and local path
Adding a share takes a protocol, host, path and optional credentials
The interface follows your desktop's light or dark preference

description.p: Add Share now offers templates and network discovery from one picker.

ul.li: Add a Start from picker to Add Share with Media Library, Backup Target, and NAS Folder templates
Move network discovery into Add Share instead of a separate Discover button
Discover nearby devices and shares advertised through the desktop network backend
Show desktop-provided device and share icons in the discovery browser
Sign in to discovered servers, explore their shares and select the exact share to save

description.p: A clearer, more focused settings experience.

ul.li: Replace the crowded About dialog with dedicated settings pages
Group share options into Connection, Credentials and Disconnect tabs
Move appearance controls into the main settings window
Improve labels, explanations, spacing and visual hierarchy

description.p: Security-first credential handling and robust multi-share management.

ul.li: Add ask-every-time, login-session and permanent keyring policies
Add reusable credential profiles for shares using the same identity
Add search, Connect All and Disconnect All controls
Refresh automatically when GVfs connections change
Add fixed-duration, screen-lock and suspend disconnect policies
Add validated configuration import and private password-free exports
Reduce the Flatpak bundle by removing unused Qt WebEngine components

description.p: Improved Flatpak integration, connection management and diagnostics.

ul.li: Show the installed version in the main window and About dialog
Add About, repository, issue-reporting and log-viewing tools
Preserve and recover share configuration across Flatpak updates
Add the GVfs client integration required to mount shares from Flatpak
Support optional SMB domains and workgroups
Prevent rejected credentials from leaving a connection frozen
Add a never-save-passwords mode with per-connection prompts
Discover and import network mounts created outside Mountie
Harden configuration, URI, link-path and duplicate-operation handling

description.p: Improved reliability and a more maintainable application structure.

ul.li: Distinguish authentication, missing-share and network connection errors
Support passwordless and anonymous network shares
Keep mount state accurate when operations fail
Safely edit and delete mounted shares after unmounting
Validate and encode network addresses, paths and IPv6 hosts
Report configuration and keyring failures without terminating
Mount and unmount SMB/CIFS, AFP, NFS, SFTP, FTP and WebDAV shares
Credentials stored in the system keyring
Short, stable local paths for mounted shares
System, light and dark themes
